tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the room photo; also the ring cut around avatars and chart dots.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Tint laid over the room photo so glass reads on top of it. Dark theme uses a radial veil built from this colour.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default frosted surface: cards, KPI tiles, page head, tabs. Always with backdrop blur `blur`.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Overlays (modal, drawer, menu, finder) and the fallback when backdrop-filter is unsupported.

tokens.name: glass-2
tokens.usage: Controls sitting on glass: buttons, chips, inputs, icon buttons, wells.

tokens.name: glass-3
tokens.usage: Hover state of `glass-2` controls; selected nav pill and segmented thumb (light).

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed tracks: segmented control, switch off, range and meter tracks, stepper.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: 1px top highlight on glass (inset 0 1px 0).

tokens.name: rim-2
tokens.usage: 1px inner outline on glass (inset 0 0 0 1px).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on `bg`, `glass` and `glass-strong`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav items, chip labels, field labels, page-head lead.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, units, timestamps, section labels, idle icons. Holds 4.5:1 on `bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the 1px inner outline of controls.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger outline: buttons, inputs, switch track, chart grid lines.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal signature: primary button, active tab/chip, switch on, focus ring, live data.

tokens.name: accent-hi
tokens.usage: Top stop of the accent gradient (160deg, accent-hi to accent) and primary hover.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` fills. Never white on teal.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint: selected choice, icon tiles, focus halo (0 0 0 4px).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons on glass: links, current nav icon, dial mode.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Coloured shadow under lit things: primary button, switch on, active device icon, hot bar.

tokens.name: cool
tokens.usage: Cooling and cold end of the thermostat tick ramp.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Heating, warm end of the tick ramp, comparison line (dashed) in charts, solar.

tokens.name: data
tokens.usage: Chart series: bars, area line, ring arc.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Positive status text and dots (online, locked, fresh air).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention status text, nav counts.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors, offline devices, danger buttons. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status text.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `good` pills and deltas.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `warn` pills and nav counts.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `bad` pills and negative deltas.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `info` pills.

tokens.name: mono-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on the pastel avatar hues `h1`–`h6` (same in both themes).

tokens.name: h1
tokens.usage: Avatar hue 1 (sand), with `mono-ink` initials.

tokens.name: h2
tokens.usage: Avatar hue 2 (sky).

tokens.name: h3
tokens.usage: Avatar hue 3 (sage).

tokens.name: h4
tokens.usage: Avatar hue 4 (rose).

tokens.name: h5
tokens.usage: Avatar hue 5 (stone).

tokens.name: h6
tokens.usage: Avatar hue 6 (mist).

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Series/category 1 (amber): scene icons, split bars.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Series/category 2 (blue).

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Series/category 3 (green).

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Series/category 4 (coral).

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Series/category 5 (stone).

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: Series/category 6 (teal).

styles.name: dial-figure
styles.usage: The thermostat reading (clamp 48–64px). Unit sits beside it in `fs-xl` muted.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page head h1, clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 38px). Enters with the split-text reveal.

styles.name: fs-lg
styles.usage: Card titles, device names, empty-state titles.

styles.name: fs-base
styles.sample: Sưởi giữ 21,5° đến 22:30, rồi hạ dần về 17° cho ban đêm. Heating holds 21.5° until 22:30.
styles.usage: Body copy and inputs. Tabular numerals are on everywhere. Be Vietnam Pro covers every Vietnamese tone mark.

styles.name: fs-md
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, tabs, menu items, table cells.

styles.name: fs-sm
styles.sample: 2 on · drag to dim, pick a colour
styles.usage: Card subtitles, chips, small buttons, field labels.

styles.name: fs-xs
styles.usage: Pills, KPI footers, device state, table heads.

styles.name: fs-2xs
styles.usage: Uppercase section and nav-group labels (0.06–0.08em); also badges and chart axes in normal case.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Gap between the viewport edge and the floating sidebar / top bar (12px at ≤999px, 10px at ≤760px).

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Grid and stack gap between cards (14px at ≤999px, 12px at ≤760px).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: side-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed (rail) sidebar width.

tokens.name: max
tokens.usage: Max content width of the main column and top bar.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles and the skip link.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Wells, toasts, tabs container.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, KPI tiles, page head, top bar, device tiles.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Sidebar, modal, drawer, sign-in card.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Drop shadow under every glass surface, after the two rim insets.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Overlays: modal, drawer, menu, finder, toast.

backdrop.note: Backdrop-filter recipes for glass. Dark theme strengthens blur to blur(30px) saturate(1.5) (bundle.css re-declares it under [data-theme=dark]).

tokens.name: blur
tokens.usage: Glass surfaces: card, kpi, tabs, page head, sidebar, top bar.

tokens.name: blur-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal, drawer, menu, finder.

ease.note: Halvo animates with GSAP. These are the CSS equivalents of its named eases; back.out(n) is given as a linear() curve. Halvo.motion.ease(name) returns the same strings.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The one CSS transition curve (dial ticks, flash). Same as GSAP power4.out.

tokens.name: ease-power3-out
tokens.usage: Default UI move: slides, staggers, magnetic follow, lift, range fill.

tokens.name: ease-expo-out
tokens.usage: Long settles: rise reveal, drawer and sheet in, meters, grow bars, boot sequence.

tokens.name: ease-power2-out
tokens.usage: Photo cross-fade, shake, bell wiggle.

tokens.name: ease-power2-in
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves: overlays out, toast out, page leave.

tokens.name: ease-power3-in
tokens.usage: Drawer and sheet out.

tokens.name: ease-power2-inout
tokens.usage: SVG line draw; theme switch circle wipe.

tokens.name: ease-power3-inout
tokens.usage: Trailing edge of the sliding pill.

tokens.name: ease-back-2
tokens.usage: GSAP back.out(2): menus, stepper roll, toasts. Springy overshoot ≈13%.

tokens.name: ease-back-3
tokens.usage: GSAP back.out(3): pop-ins, badges, icon nudge. Overshoot ≈25%.

duration.note: Durations from the source motion kit. All collapse to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-tick
tokens.usage: Page leave base unit; finder out.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Scrim fade, toast out.

tokens.name: dur-swift
tokens.usage: Sliding pill leading edge; stepper roll 0.35s.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Most UI moves: switch knob, finder in, lift, item stagger.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: Drawer in, badge pop, icon pop.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Split-text title reveal, card deal, rise 0.8s.

tokens.name: dur-long
tokens.usage: Number count-up, line draw 1.1s, meter 1s.
